body:
I agree, we might not want to have beta changelog in the final one. But, I would appreciate to still have changes for the beta in a changelog.

Can we try to have this flow for beta:

* tag locally the beta
* generate the changelog & update it
* remove the tag locally

And when we have a non-beta, re-generate the changelog from start so it removes the "beta" parts of it? What do you think?
